name: Groovy Company Inc
summary: Groovy Company Inc. is actively engaged in the exploration and extraction of metals. Its multifaceted business operations span the domains of blockchain technology, the cannabis industry, advanced data analytics, and customer loyalty initiatives. A core aspect of its offerings includes the full-spectrum development, management, and operation of Blockchain-as-a-Service (BaaS) platforms. Furthermore, the company is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge solutions like smart digital contracts, non-fungible tokens (NFTs), the tokenization of both digital and physical assets, extended reality (XR) applications, and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. Established in 2009, this Atlanta, Georgia-based firm was originally known as Santo Mining Corp. It adopted its current name, Groovy Company Inc., in May 2025 and functions as a subsidiary of the Pineapple Express Cannabis Company.
